reasoning: Section 3(a)(1) applies when a licensee Shares Licensed Material, including in modified form. Under Section 3(a)(1)(A)(ii)–(iv), the licensee retains each of the copyright notice, notice referring to the license, and notice referring to the warranty disclaimer when the Licensor supplied that item with the material.
